pkg/secrets credential and token redaction applied to curl commands, Python scripts, and Go snippets

transparent_limitations: Phase 7.2 authorizes deterministic PoC generation, static validation, and isolated mock simulation ONLY. Phase 7.3 (Remediation Diff Generator) and 7.4 (Executive Dossier) remain strictly BLOCKED.
State-changing vulnerabilities are restricted to dry-run or inspection checks; no real account takeovers, password changes, or data modifications are dispatched.
Mock simulation against in-memory HTTP fixtures validates protocol generation logic without claiming compromise of a live cloud IAM role or real production database.

Full repository regression (go test ./...) encounters offline local containers (WebGoat :8080, NodeGoat :4000) in pkg/auth; all target packages for pkg/exploit, pkg/correlation, pkg/mobile, pkg/assessment pass with Exit Code 0.
